basic_info.description: Bathed in natural light and full of Bernal charm, this partially detached 3BD/1.5BA home sits directly across from Holly Park - a vibrant neighborhood gem with a playground, baseball field, scenic trails, and plenty of space for pups to roam. Enjoy postcard-worthy views of the park, Bernal Hill, and peek-a-boo glimpses of the San Francisco skyline. Inside, a formal entry leads to a sunny double parlor with two living spaces - one featuring a retro-style fireplace and a perfectly placed niche ideal for a bar cart or cozy reading corner. The updated, generously sized eat-in kitchen flows off the parlor and sets the stage for easy entertaining, while a bright full bath completes the main level. Upstairs are two spacious bedrooms with a handy half bath in between. The third bedroom - ideal for guests, a home office, or creative retreat - is tucked away on the ground level with direct access to a deep, gloriously-sized backyard. Two-car parking in the driveway, a south-facing front garden, laundry in the garage with room to tinker, vintage details throughout, and abundant light round out this easygoing Bernal beauty located just blocks from Cortland and close to transit and freeways.
